title: YouTube Metadata with FlashData
description: Get YouTube video details, available chapters and format metadata from one video ID. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: 11-character YouTube video ID (the v= value in a watch URL).

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Requires youtube_metadata access. Get your key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

include_formats.title: Include Formats
include_formats.description: Include available video/audio format metadata, without downloading files.
